traps: The Tanal-Lavu exchange (m6-m11) must never appear in a summary built for Kyle Weber or the other wide-group members
Mark Kaye is cc'd on the side thread and never writes: no position
Josh Klein, Kyle Weber and the other To/Cc names on the memo thread have no position on BEPMM
'Ratnakar' appears in the reviewers' m5 request before he writes anything: that is a request to confirm alignment, not his position
Stephen thanking Ratnakar for his 'readiness to partner' (m8) is politeness, not agreement with Ratnakar's recommendation
Ratnakar's 'I agree with your point of working closer to the teams' (m9) agrees on embedding resources only, not on the funding ask
Ratnakar's 'we are adding more letters to this' (BEPMMCI) is a joke on the name, not a new option
The $ figures belong to the memo's ask quoted in m7, not to Ratnakar's own proposal
m12 'FYI....keep it to yourself' is the forwarder's note, not Ratnakar's view on the content
